description: Annual manual rates for Pakistan Finance Calculators. Never touched by automated bots. Updated annually via Finance Act or Ramadan notifications.

salaryTax.source: Federal Board of Revenue (FBR), Finance Act 2026, Section 149

propertyTax.source: Federal Board of Revenue (FBR), Income Tax Ordinance 2001, Sections 236C & 236K, Finance Act 2026

salesTaxGST.source: Sales Tax Act 1990, as amended to 30 June 2026
salesTaxGST.servicesNote: Provincial rates vary by PRA, SRB, KPRA, and BRA.

fitrana.source: Mufti Muneeb-ur-Rehman (21 Feb 2026) & Council of Islamic Ideology (Ramadan 2026)

governmentBankNisab.source: Ministry of Poverty Alleviation & SBP BPRD Circular Letter No. 03 of 2026
governmentBankNisab.note: Applicable strictly to automatic bank deductions on 1st Ramadan, not personal nisab.
